visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a small, round yellow cat figurine with a tiny black hat sitting inside a clear plastic bowl-like structure. The bowl is mounted on a yellow plastic pole. The background is softly blurred, showing a tan sofa and a large plush toy. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of nine various cat and animal figurines, including a grey cat, a brown cat, and a small rabbit, scattered across a light blue surface. (3) Hands enter the frame to assemble a yellow modular cat house, placing a square module with a circular entrance onto a flat base plate. (4) A hand carefully inserts a smiling yellow cat figurine into the entrance of the yellow house module. (5) A transparent hemispherical bowl with cat-eared rims is shown being attached to a vertical yellow screw-type pole. (6) A yellow and orange striped cat toy is placed into the transparent bowl, appearing to sit comfortably. (7) A close-up reveals a yellow square plate with a textured, hexagonal grid pattern, representing a scratching board for the toy set. (8) Hands place a small, circular blue fabric cushion inside the house module for the figurines to sit on. (9) Hands present two small accessories: a pink pig-like figure and a grey cat figure, holding them close to the camera lens. (10) The pink accessory is placed inside the house module alongside the grey cat figurine. (11) A brown striped cat toy is shown being moved as if jumping onto a yellow elevated platform. (12) Hands stack an additional square house module on top of an existing one to create a multi-story structure. (13) The camera shows a view from beneath the transparent bowl, showing the yellow cat toy's paws and belly through the plastic. (14) An angry-looking yellow tiger cat toy is held by hands and then placed onto a high yellow platform. (15) The hands continue to assemble the playground, adding more vertical poles and platform modules. (16) A small cat figure peeks its head over the rim of the transparent bowl, with its front paws resting on the edge. (17) Hands place a soft pink cushion and a black cat figure with large yellow eyes into a yellow house module. (18) A wide shot reveals the completed, multi-tiered yellow cat tree populated with all the various characters and accessories. (19) The camera pans across the elaborate toy setup, showing the diverse feline characters in their respective modules. (20) Close-up shots highlight the small details of the accessories, including the blue cushion and different cat expressions. (21) The final shot returns to the main yellow cat figurine in the clear bowl, centered with promotional text overlays and the brand logo at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic BGM (128 BPM) begins with a bright synth lead. A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice exclaims '開箱' (Unboxing), setting an energetic tone. (2) A crisp plastic 'click' SFX triggers as the modular parts are joined. The female narrator speaks rapidly, detailing the DIY aspect with a friendly and commercial tone. (3) A distinct 'ding' bell SFX highlights a feature introduction. The BGM maintains a steady, bouncy four-on-the-floor beat with moderate harmonic complexity. (4) A cute, stylized 'meow' sound effect plays as a cat figurine is inserted. The audio spectrum is bright with high energy in the upper frequencies. (5) Multiple rapid-fire 'tap' and 'pop' SFX are synchronized with the placement of small toy accessories. The narrator giggles excitedly in between descriptive phrases. (6) A 'boing' jump SFX sounds as a figurine is placed on a platform. The voice intensity remains consistently high throughout the assembly process. (7) A percussive 'thud' SFX marks the stacking of house modules. The background music continues with its upbeat, major-key melody. (8) A soft 'whoosh' transition sound precedes another 'meow' SFX. The narrator's speech rate increases as more features are listed. (9) The audio density peaks with a combination of speech, music, and mechanical clicking sounds. The female voice reaches a high arousal level as she completes the 'harem'. (10) A final shimmer SFX and a melodic stinger conclude the track as the narrator delivers a warm call to action over the fading BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote and showcase a modular cat-themed toy set ('Mini Harem') by demonstrating its assembly and the cuteness of its various characters. It uses high-energy editing and enthusiastic narration to appeal to fans of the 'fumeancat' brand.
